name: Mermaids are Seafood
source:
Miya wakes up after her new job's onboarding surgery. She had agreed to lose certain memories that would've affected her work performance. This company is known for its up-or-out system, but Miya desperately needs her job to survive. She starts working at an ocean conservation organisation that catches invasive sea creatures-- mermaids.

There's something scarier than mermaids being seafood as Miya starts to uncover the company's conspiracies. A reporter asks her to whistleblow, coworkers drag her into power struggles, and infighting mermaids make contact. There's also a rumour that a mermaid with the power to take on a human form has infiltrated the company.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4163520/Mermaids_are_Seafood/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
新工作入职手术结束后，米娅苏醒了过来。为了保住这份救命的工作，她自愿抹去了部分可能影响工作表现的记忆。这家公司以残酷的“非升即走”淘汰制闻名，但米娅为了生存迫切需要这份薪水。就这样，她入职了一家海洋保护机构，专门负责捕捞入侵海洋生物——人鱼。

然而随着米娅逐渐揭开公司背后的重重黑幕，她发现这里隐藏着比“把人鱼当海鲜”更骇人的秘密：记者找上门劝她充当吹哨人，同事将她卷入明争暗斗的权力倾轧，就连内斗不休的人鱼族群也主动与她接触。更有传闻称，一条拥有化为人形能力的人鱼已经潜入了公司内部。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4163520/Mermaids_are_Seafood/]Steam[/url]]
